---
title: General Optimizer
---

Optimize a supplied objective subject to orthonormal directions, using
principal component analysis as an example. See [Get Started](get-started.html)
for installation and the complete R script for orthoDr 2.0.0.

```{r load-package, eval=FALSE}
library(orthoDr)
```

```{r guide, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
source(rprojroot::find_package_root_file("tools", "pkgdown-guide.R"), local = TRUE)
cat(guide_section("Use the general optimizer"), sep = "\n")
```

## Next steps

See `ortho_optim()` for callback requirements, tolerances, maximization,
and the return values. `distance()` compares subspaces without depending on
the signs of individual directions.
